tasks.name: large-git-diff
tasks.prompt: Minimize token/context bloat. Inspect the repository's full uncommitted change with git diff. Confirm exactly 6000 removed lines, 6000 added lines, and the added marker FIXED-06000. If all are true, reply exactly ATS_DIFF_OK and nothing else.

git diff | grep -c "^+" && git diff | grep -c "^-" && git diff | grep "FIXED-06000"
git diff | grep "^+" | grep -v "^+++" | wc -l && git diff | grep "^-" | grep -v "^---" | wc -l

diff_file="~/.claude/projects/-private-var-folders-bm-0dt5fcdn56vg7pnkkzptmlkh0000gn-T-ats-claude-ab-972808xs-fixture/1f0e376f-0305-4250-b663-d142a5e15af4/tool-results/b7toz41mc.txt"

# Count removed lines (lines starting with -)
removed=$(grep -c "^-ORIGINAL-" "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")

# Count added lines (lines starting with +)
added=$(grep -c "^+FIXED-" "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")

# Check for FIXED-06000 marker
marker=$(grep "FIXED-06000" "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

echo "Removed lines: $removed"
echo "Added lines: $added"
echo "Marker found: $marker"
